La Grange Women's Ride

Los Angeles, CA · Westside · Road

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

La Grange Women's Ride is a road group ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls third Saturday of the month at 8:00 am. About 25–40 miles, social, 16–18 mph on flats, regroups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @veloclublagrange the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the La Grange Women's Ride group ride

Monthly ride for female-identifying cyclists, members and guests. Social pace with regroups; the club says no one gets left behind. Riders should be comfortable clipped in and have some climbing experience. Start location rotates and is posted on Strava and Instagram.
